balls.text: full pitched again, driven to long-on and they have taken a single, come back for the second and there is an appeal for a run-out at the striker's end, the batsman is only slightly in, an excellent end to the innings
finally gets the length right, pitched right up, swinging in too, Harris wants to swing it away, inside edge to mid-wicket for a single
pitched up this time but this is too full, takes him on the full-toss, thwacked over the deep mid-wicket region for another four!
short of length and that has been whacked away over mid-wicket for a six!
short of length, pushed to the point, he is unsure of the single, Harris calls him through and could have been out, run-out at the non-striker's end had it hit
short of length, slams it down the ground for a single

bowled him, the middle stump is flattened! It was on the stumps and Chawla was trying to go up and over, missed it completely and the stump is knocked back, fourth wicket for Morkel, 25 wickets for him now in IPL
another yorker length, dug out well to the off side and they are off for a single, the fielder at short cover fields well and shies at the non-striker's stumps, hits but the batsman is in the crease
full-toss on his pads, flicked away to the deep square-leg, the fielder has to run to his left and they are able to come back for the second

yorker and bowled, leg stump on the ground! Singh was trying to give himself a lot of room there, as he had been doing against Russell, but this is a far superior quality bowler we are looking at and the leg-stump is sent packing
full-toss, he wants to go over the top, in the end, manages to drive it to the sweeper for a single
pitched up, outside the off stump, sliced it and straight to the point fielder, quickly to the fielder and he pouches it well
full ball outside the off stump, dug out well by the batsman, to third-man for a single
and again, outside the off stump, pitched up and he is trying to go over the top through the covers, but for the third time this over, he has missed it, Mahmood wants a wide!
outside the off stump and really quick, 139.4 km/hr, wants to go over the extra-cover region, misses
loose ball on his pads, full toss and that has been tonked over the deep square-leg region for a six!
outside the off stump, swinging away again, pitched up too, enough to entice him to go for a drive, misses
full-toss from Aaron, squeezes it out, digs it hard into the pitch and bounces over the bowler for a single
and another four, deft placement, outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat, it was a slower ball, it goes really fine to beat Morkel on the boundary

outside the off stump, way outside, pitched up, he was attempting to drive it through the covers, then checked the stroke, went up in the air and through to the right of the deep cover fielder for a four!
pitched up to the bat, yorker length on the leg stump, flicked away to long-on for a single
shorter, slower from Russell too and that has slapped away to the vacant mid-wicket region for a four, three in a row!
pitched up to the batsman, he gives room, and that has been casually hit over the bowler, to long-off, no fielder there!
short ball, top-edged by the batsman and it should have been caught by Varun Aaron at fine-leg, dropped and goes for a four!
down the leg side from Russell, full-pitcher and left alone by the batsman, wide called
short, wide and bouncing a lot more than he expected, wants to cut it away, misses it
full-toss from Pathan and he wants to loft it over mid-wicket, misses it, he hasn't got too much of his timing going so far but has played a sterling role
outside the off stump, full toss, driven to the deep cover region for a single
pitched up, outside the off stump, driven to short cover
on the pads, short of length and that has been flicked away over backward square-leg for a six, a pick-up stroke for a maximum!
pitched right up and driven down the ground to long-off for a single
outside the off stump and almost guided over the point fielder for a four! Too short and wide again but it never looked like he was attempting to hit it, almost caressed it away
pitched right up to the bat, outside the off stump, drilled to the covers for a single
short of length, lot of bounce and the batsman is on the back foot, fended it off to the leg side for a single
slower one from Russell, the batsman was shaping to lift it over the extra-cover, before checking his stroke and late dabbing it to third-man
length ball, bouncing a lot more than he expected, defended on the back foot to the off side

short ball, wanted to pull it away, gets a top edge, it was always going to fall safely between the fielders before Pathan ran back from inside the circle, brought one of his hands out and snapped that out of nowhere!

yorker length again, driven back to the bowler, goes through to the area between long-on and long-off, Russell dives, fields and flicks it to Morkel, who rips the throw in to the bowler, only a single
slower ball, he waited for it and then opened the face of the bat to backward point, a quick single taken
yorker length ball yet again, Mahmood was coming on to his front foot, brings his foot away, taps it away to mid-on
quickish yorker, he is on the back foot, flicks it away to square-leg for a single
pitched fuller, outside the off stump, he was giving himself room to play it inside out, misses the outside edge through to the wicket-keeper
on his pads, half volley too, he goes over the top but to the long-on fielder on the bounce

short of length, nudged to the off side, they go for a quick single, the fielder did well to rush in, pick up and throw at the striker's end, misses the stumps. The batsman was out of the crease there.
cut away over the backward point region, goes quickly to the third-man, Morkel runs around and throws it back to the wicket-keeper
opens his stance up, wants to hoick it over the leg side, but goes to the mid-wicket fielder
short ball, had to hurriedly pull it away to the square-leg fielder and they take a single
shortens his length, swings in as well, cut away to the point fielder, Warner has a shy at the stumps, misses
down the track, outside the off stump, takes it almost on the full and that is drilled over the extra-cover region for a six!
on the leg side, hits his foot rather hard, gets a leg-bye through to fine-leg
outside the off stump, gives himself some room, cut away through the covers, the sweeper fielder, Negi runs to his left and dive but the ball escapes through for a four
outside the off stump, guides to the third-man for a single
on his pads yet again, he tries to flick it away for the second time in a row, hits the pads again and to the short fine-leg fielder
down the leg side, he tries to heave it away, gets only some pad through to the keeper, bit of an appeal from the keeper, but not-out
pitched right up to the bat, dug out by the batsman, to the left of the bowler, goes to long-off for a single
powerful cut away through left of point and that has finally gone to the fence, Mahmood had been trying to dart them through that region but was finding the fielder so far
length ball, shaping into the batsman, opens the face of the bat, to the point fielder
outside the off stump, short of length, wants to cut it away, misses
outside the off stump, pitched up, he tries to go over the top on the leg side, gets the bottom of the bat and it lands just short of the fielder at deep square-leg
goes down the track, outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat through to the left of the point fielder, by the time he fields it, they are off for a single
outside the off stump, Mahmood wants to cut it away but goes straight to the point fielder

short ball and that has been pulled away to mid-wicket for a four! Poor bowling from Russell, on a track where the ball is still nipping around, he has chosen to bowl a length that is not quite conducive to swing bowling
leg side, touch of glove and that he is able to fend it away to the fine-leg fence for a four, second one of the over!
on the middle stump, this time he is able to flick it away to the fine-leg for a single
on a length, moving away from the batsman, tries to open the face of the bat, hits the inside bottom of the bat and goes on the bounce to the keeper
on the middle stump, bit of holding of line there, he was tries to flick it away, gets a bit of a leading edge and it goes over the extra-cover fielder
pitched slightly fuller, he heaves it over the bowler's head, it was a bit of a slog over leg side but it gets a top-edge and it has gone away for a four
straighter this time, pushed to the off side and that is a call for the Time-Out
width from the bowler, outside the off stump and it was short too, but I think the lack of pace killed Mahmood's attempt to cut it, goes to point
this is on the middle and swinging into the batsman, he tries to flick it away, hits his pads, and there is a call of 'wait'
swings back into the batsman yet again, but not too much pace, defended on the front foot, to the off side
on the middle stump, shaping into the batsman, flicks it away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, driven but straight to the short cover fielder
short ball from Russell, attempts a pull, hits the top edge and goes over the wicket-keeper and almost goes all the way, one bounce for a four
short of length, on to the back foot again, punched to wide mid-off, goes quickly to the fielder and they avoid the single
short and wide outside the off stump, wants to cut it away, gets it on the bottom of the bat, it goes over the in-field, mistimed stroke
slightly fuller, still on the length, goes on to the back foot, flicks it to the leg side for a single
short of length, the batsman is on the back foot, fended away but back to the bowler
short of length, outside the off stump, Mahmood opens the face of the bat and plays it to backward point, Warner runs to his left and by the time he has fielded, there is a single on offer
up and over, short, wide and that allows the batsman to free his arms, was able to slash it away for a four!
length ball, on the off stump, he is still looking to play on the leg side, flicks it to square-leg, to the fielder
short of length, flicked away to square-leg, the batsman calls for a second immediately, and they make it comfortably
outside the off stump, fuller, driven to short mid-off and fielded well by Morkel
from outside the off stump, nipping back into the batsman, short of length too, nudged to the leg side and he wants a run, Mahmood pushes him back
outside the off stump, length ball, defended on the off side, 143 km/hr
down the leg side, left alone by the batsman and that is a wide
on the middle stump, pitched up to the batsman and Mahmood, on the front foot, defends it back to the bowler
short ball, wants to pull it away, gets only a top edge and that has gone up in the air, straight to mid-on for Pathan to take his second catch of the day
outside the off stump, length ball, pushed to the covers, where Chand slips and allows the ball through for a single
fuller again, tries to flick it away, goes only to short mid-wicket
pitched up this time, he was on the back foot was the batsman to this full ball, tries to flick it away at the last moment, goes only to the right of the bowler
full-toss, outside the off stump, cut away by Hussey but goes to third-man for a single
bounce again, what a ball, it was pitched just short of length and it has taken off from there, the batsman gets out of the way, happy that the over is done
length ball, a lot of bounce on that, and Chitnis had no option but to play and miss at it, did not get any bat on it
outside the off stump, moving away, length ball and he lets it go through to the keeper

upper cut, gone, caught! There was too much bounce on that one, he was trying to play it over the third-man fielder, but he gets only enough bat to get it to the third-man fielder, simple catch for Pathan
short of length, on the middle stump, on to the back foot, pushed to the covers and they are off for a single
outside the off stump, widish, wants to go for an expansive drive, but fails to make contact with the bat
and he keeps playing those on the up shots through covers, or at least keeps attempting them, misses again, it was a good length ball that missed the outside edge of the bat
short of length, on to the back foot, opens the face of the bat, to third-man for a single
full-toss, almost like it slipped out of his hands, trying a yorker, pushed to square-leg but straight to the fielder
short of length ball, went for the pull, gets it high on his bat and the top-edge carries through to mid-on, Varun Aaron dives forward and takes a good catch there!
pitched right up to the bat, on the middle stump, driven to mid-off and they are off for a single
outside the off stump, length ball, he was driving it on the up, the extra bounce and pace beats his outside edge
shot, over the in-field and four, 150.8 km/hr, pitched up and Gilchrist gave it his all, did not look very well-timed but it still goes almost all the way!
pitched fuller now, he is still on his back foot, drives to mid-on, stray thoughts of a single are banished
over the wicket, short of length, tucking his body, stands tall on his back foot, defends it away
cut away and for four, some width from round the stumps and he throws his bat at it, goes over point for a four!
short of length, outside the off stump, punched to the point region
short of length, round the stumps, wants to pull it away but does not time it well and it goes to fine-leg
short of length, on the off stump, on the back foot and punches it to the off side but straight to the fielder
pitched fuller this time, swinging away from the batsman, he goes for a drive, misses it, through to the keeper
short ball, outside the off stump and it still seamed away from the batsman, went for a cut, missed it
on the off stump, swinging away from the bat, pitched fuller as well, defended on the front foot by Valthaty
pitched up, outside the off stump and confidently defended on the front foot, goes to the off side
edged and gone, first ball! That was swinging away from the bat, short of length, Mandeep could have left that alone but was sucked into nibbling at it and the edge goes through to the wicket-keeper
and another one outside the off stump, pitched right up to the batsman, goes for a drive and the out-swing beats the batsman, through to the keeper
length ball and that takes off from there, Gilchrist would have played a lot of cricket at WACA but he was still struggling to get anywhere close to that one!
short of length, on to the back foot and attempts to punch it back, bounces hard into the ground
outside the off stump, fuller again, this time the batsman lets it go alone, safely through to the keeper
outside the off stump, pitched up this time, Gilchrist went for a slash, misses it through to the wicket-keeper
short of length ball, bounced on Gilchrist, who defends it on the back foot, punched to the covers
wide outside the off stump and left all alone, the wicket-keeper had no chance of getting to it especially with all that swing, hits the gloves and still goes through for a four!
on the leg stump, he was trying to flick it, gets an outside edge and goes through the slips for a four, end of the match and end of Punjab's stay in this season of the IPL
outside the off stump, swinging away and that has beaten the outside edge of the bat
swinging in to the batsman, short of length, he was giving himself room too, gets an inside edge
opens the face of the bat, down to the third-man for a single
short of length, outside the off stump, defended to point
on the middle stump, defended to mid-wicket
short and pulled away to fine-leg for a single
up and over and slashed for four over backward point, not a good day for PK today
outside the off stump, defended to the off side and that ends another successful over from Mahmood
short ball, wants to pull it away, top edged it away and Hussey takes a simple catch at mid-off, still fighting to survive in the game and hence, in the tournament
shimmies down the pitch and has lofted it over Mahmood's head for a four, straight bat and a couple of bounces for a four
outside the off stump, still moving away, it was a length ball and beats the outside edge of the bat!
short of length, pushed away to the backward square-leg for a single, no wait, they are coming back for the second too
outside the off stump, pushed to the covers and they get nothing
short and cut over third-man for a six, that was back to bowling poorly was Awana and Rao takes full toll of that one
inside out, to extra-cover and for four, was pitched right up to the bat and driven over the top for a one-bounce four
outside the off stump, played away to third-man for a single
on the off stump, pitched right up and pushed to mid-off for nothing again
outside the off stump, swinging away yet again and misses the cut shot
outside the off stump, pitched fuller, driven to mid-off
length ball, swinging away from the batsman and misses the outside edge, end of Harris' four-over spell, an excellent one at that
bouncer again and he tries to hit it over the third-man, misses the upper cut and to the keeper
short ball, ducked into it and that one seemed to swing after it passed the batsman
on the middle stump, played away gently to square-leg and is off the mark
edged and gone, caught at slips! Outside the off stump, there were hard hands at it, trying to drive it, gets an outside edge to the lone slip, catches it well
outside the off stump, pitched fuller, driven to mid-off and a single is refused
on the off stump, pushed to the off side
now that is a poor stroke, outside the off stump, short as well, he was trying to paddle it, from wide, wide away, top edge loops up and falls in no-man's land
quicker on the middle stump and Pathan brings his foot out, defended back
on his pads, goes for a paddle sweep, hits his pads and they are able to come back for the second run
outside the off stump, pitched up too, no turn, goes straight on and beats him
pitched up finally by Chawla, driven gently to long-off for a single. He wasn't doing that when Warner was at the crease and for obvious reasons too.
inside edge and that has gone for four, on the off stump, too quick for Pathan who was trying to defend it, gets a bit of an edge and that has gone for a four!
punched and straight to point, gone, end of an excellent innings from Warner! It was a bit short and he wanted to slap it through point but goes to hand
short ball, pegs the batsman to the back foot, fends it off to the leg side and they are able to get a single
outside the off stump, short of length too, wants to cut it away but goes to the fielder, they are able to come back for a single
short of length, outside the off stump, punched to the point and to the fielder
short of length, on the leg stump, pushed to square-leg for a single
shorter and keeps low, wanted to push it to the leg side again, misses the bat and the stumps, Warner survives!
shorter again and this time he swivels around and pushes it to backward square-leg and a couple of runs for the Aussie
shorter from Chawla, rocks on to the back foot and slaps it through mid-wicket for a four!
on the back foot and defended to the off side, it was quicker too
tries to cut a ball that is too near to do so, misses the middle of the bat, gets the edge, thickish one, dropped by Gilly and goes for a four!
pitched right up to the bat, defended cautiously and back to the bowler
on the off stump, swinging away slightly, defended on the front foot to the point region and they decide to stay put in their crease
short of length, outside the off stump, pushed to the covers and to the fielder
yorker on the leg stump, driven to long-on and for a single
round the stumps, punched to the extra-cover fielder, on the bounce
fuller this time and this is an even better shot from Warner! Quicker and he is on to the back foot and drills it between deep mid-wicket and long-on!
short ball and what a shot from Warner, pulled over the leg side and that has beaten deep square-leg and deep mid-wicket with ease!
outside the off stump, going straight on and left alone by the batsman
quicker down the leg side and well taken by the keeper, wide called by the umpire
floated up this this time, wanted to defend it, spins away and beaten
outside the off stump, fuller as well and the batsman throws his bat at it, goes over the in field for a couple of runs to the right of the sweeper fielder
on the pads, quicker, pushes to the leg side, wanted a single
short ball, he was still till the last moment and then went for the cut, goes to the sweeper for a single
on the off stump, turning away, pushed to the off side

slog attempted and caught by the keeper! It was the last ball of a good over from Mahmood, wanted to heave away the short of length ball to the deep square-leg region, gets the toe end of the bat and it goes high up in the air, Gilly runs across and does well to catch it
on the middle stump, worked away to backward square leg from the stumps and they easily come back for the second
on the off stump but short of length again, pushes to the off side and wants a single, Warner sends him back
short of length, outside the off stump, wanted to go for the cut but that was seaming away from the batsman and he misses that
on the off stump, pushed up, punched to the off side
swinging in from outside the off stump, almost went through his defences, manages to get his bat down in time, pushed to long-on for a single
down the leg side, and yes there is some swing, but it is a wide
on the off stump, pushed to long-on for a single and the ump calls for the Time-Out
on the off stump, played away to the leg side, quickly goes for a single, wanted a second which is thwarted because Warner slips
quicker, shorter, on the middle stump, pulled to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
was on the back foot yet again, beaten, gets an outside edge and it still goes through the third-man for a four!
shorter, quicker, defended on the back foot to the leg side
outside the off stump, guides it to the point fielder, should have been fielded, but goes through the fielder as if he was invisible and it has gone for a four that brings Warner's fifty!

round the wicket, pulled and dropped! This was bound to happen some time given that he was going for his strokes, the fielders needed to be awake to the situation, the pull shot loops to Mandeep Singh at deep square-leg, he had to come in, gets both his hands and spills it.
six again, this is excellent stuff, short ball again and that has been tonked over the mid0wicket region for another big one, crazy batting taking the game well away from the hosts

short ball from Awana yet again and that has been tonked over deep mid-wicket for a six! This has been an excellent display of batting from a batsman who had not so recently been hit and bled by a bouncer.
short of a length, outside the off stump, pushed hard to the covers and there is loud call of 'Wait On!'

what a shot, excellent bashing there from Warner, outside the off stump, quick, full and Warner has smashed it over extra-cover for a four, the bat seems to be broke and now need treatment. Or a new one.
short ball from Awana and Warner was not holding back, he goes for the full-bloodied pull and that has been dispatched outside the ground! They are searching for the ball now
length ball, swinging away from the batsman, defended carefully on the back foot
on the off stump, goes on to the back foot, pushed to mid-on
short of length, outside the off stump, pulls in front of the field, was going straight back, Chitnis dives at mid-on to stop it
poor, poor ball from PK, from round the stumps, slanting it into the batsman, but that goes too wide down the leg side, enough to beat the bat of Warner and gloves of Gilly
fuller this time, angling into the batsman, pins him to the back foot, hits his pads and loops up to the off side
round the stumps, Warner was giving himself some room to probably go through the covers, follows him, shorter too, went for the pull in the end and gets the gloves
short of length, no swing for PK, on the middle stump too, he half-pulls, half-flicks it to the deep square-leg region for a four!
and length ball again, pushes him to the back foot, dead bats it to the off side
pitched right up to the bat, outside the off stump, he was probably expecting another short one, was on the back foot and manages to push it to the covers
short of length yet again, pushed on the back foot,  jumps up and defends to the off side
short of length, outside the off stump, pushed to the off side
short of length and he has pulled it over long-on off the front-foot for a six! Wow!
short of length outside the off stump, pushed to the off side
short of length, on the middle stump, he was jumping up, trying to flick it away, misses and it hits his pads
short ball and smack on his helmet! Following that fuller ball, Harris bowls a bouncer, goes for a pull, misses and that has hit the grill rather hard
full, wide, sweetly driven through the extra-cover region for a four, rushes through extra-cover
unsure of the length, Warner's on the back foot, swinging in to him from outside the off stump, gets an inside edge, to fine-leg for a couple
fuller outside the off stump, wants to swing it over leg side, gets an outside edge and it balloons up to the third-man region, Chawla comes in and allows only a single
on the pads, fuller as well, driven to the leg side but straight to the short mid-on fielder
short of length, pushed on the back foot to mid-on, there is some hesitation before they go through for a single
outside the off stump, short of a good length, wanted to pull it away, which is not such a bad idea but the width outside the off stump, makes it slightly difficult
on the off stump, length ball moving away and pushed to the covers
length ball, darting into the batsman, defended on the back foot
good length outside the off stump, tries to cut it away, gets a bit of an inside edge, hard into the ground and on the bounce to the slips
on the middle stump, short of length and this time it is Chand who swivels away and that bat swing is quick and precise, over fine-leg for a six!
defended this time, smartly played for a chance, pitched on the middle, slight swing, pushed to the off side
and again, beats him outside the off stump yet again, on the off stump and moving away, misses the outside-edge of the bat
pitched slightly fuller this time goes for a wild slog, misses by a mile does Warner and through to the keeper
short of length and beats Warner all ends, was playing on the back foot, misses the outside edge of the bat
outside the off stump, pitched up as well and driven through the covers for a four, it was in the air
short of length, on the back foot, defended to the off side

on the middle stump, swinging away from the batsman, he pushes it to the off side, through the covers and it trickles over like it is going for a single, but gathers pace and they manage to take three!
length ball yet again, quickly on to the back foot, defended back to the bowler yet again
pitched much fuller this time, on the back foot and driven to mid-on

short ball and he has plastered it over mid-wicket for a six! That was his first ball, would you believe it, they were getting in all those fielders in the cordon and he has smacked it away over midwicket
on his pads, short of length, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
outside the off stump, swinging into the bat, tries to drive on the up, to the covers
